title: Automated Legal Discovery for Mid-Sized Firms
business: Mid-sized legal firms managing high-volume document discovery for litigation.
problem: Firms struggle with the high cost of processing massive document sets while needing high-level reasoning to identify relevant evidence across thousands of pages.
solution: GPT-5.6 Terra provides a balanced intelligence-to-cost ratio, allowing firms to utilize its 1,050,000 context window to analyze entire case files in a single pass without the overhead of premium flagship models.
steps: Ingest raw discovery documents into a centralized repository.
Utilize the Chat Completions API with gpt-5.6-terra to perform semantic indexing of the documents.
Configure reasoning.effort to medium to ensure accurate legal classification while maintaining cost efficiency.
Implement prompt caching for recurring case-law references to reduce input token costs.
Output structured findings using structured_outputs for direct integration into case management software.
outcome: Firms achieve comprehensive document review coverage with predictable operational costs, enabling faster case preparation without exceeding budget constraints.
limitation: The model's performance on highly nuanced legal synthesis may degrade if reasoning.effort is set too low; verify accuracy by comparing outputs against a small human-reviewed sample set.
